literal: Thought joined heart-in strength to those who possess, always woman joined-becoming folly is not.
translation: Those who possess a strong mind filled with deep thought will never suffer the folly that comes from being subservient to a woman.
modern: சிறந்த எண்ணங்கள் நிறைந்த நெஞ்சத்தின் வலிமை உடையவர்களுக்கு, எந்தக் காலத்திலும் மனைவியின் விருப்பத்திற்கு வளைந்து கொடுப்பதால் வரும் அறியாமை இருக்காது.
explanation: The word 'எண்' refers to deep thought or wisdom, and 'இடன்' refers to the spaciousness or strength of the mind. The couplet states that men who possess a strong, thoughtful mind will not fall into the foolishness of blindly following a woman's dictates. Their inner strength and clarity of thought protect them from such weakness at all times. The phrase 'பெண் சேர்ந்தாம் பேதைமை' specifically points to the folly that arises from inappropriate subservience to a wife.
